name: Lordaeron
summary: Across Lordaeron, the Scourge, Sylvanas Windrunner’s Forsaken, and desperate survivors contest the ruined kingdoms. Once the heart of human civilization and the Alliance, the northern subcontinent was laid waste in the Third War.

sections.title: Cradle of Northern Humanity
sections.body:
Lordaeron takes its name from the human city-state that rose in the north after the ancient Empire of Arathor. In time, it became the most powerful of the human kingdoms. The region runs from the rugged Arathi Highlands in the south, across forests and waterways, toward Quel'Thalas.

It nurtured kingdoms such as Lordaeron, Dalaran, Gilneas, and Alterac. Tirisfal and Hillsbrad were known for fertile farmland, while mountains held strongholds. The land was also a sacred cradle of the Holy Light.

sections.title: The Scourge and the Fall
sections.body: During the Third War, the Lich King's invasion struck Lordaeron first. The Cult of the Damned used tainted grain to turn countless northern citizens into mindless undead. Prince Arthas Menethil fell to darkness, then returned from Northrend and killed his father, King Terenas Menethil II. He orchestrated the slaughter of the Capital City. The thriving heartland soon rotted into the blighted Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Contested Wasteland
sections.body: Lordaeron is now a brutal battleground of fractured loyalties. Beneath the Capital City's ruins, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken have made the Undercity, a sovereign realm of free-willed undead aligned with the Horde. In the east, the Lich King's mindless Scourge hold corrupted keeps and strongholds. Human zealots of the Scarlet Crusade, surviving Alliance settlements in Hillsbrad, and wild forest trolls clash over what remains.

faq.answer: Lordaeron names both the northern subcontinent of the Eastern Kingdoms and the former human kingdom that ruled its central lands. The region stretches from the Thandol Span at the Arathi border north toward Quel'Thalas, across mountains, forests, and inland lakes.

No single power controls all of Lordaeron. Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken hold Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine from their subterranean Undercity. The Scourge, under Kel'Thuzad, remains powerful in the Plaguelands, while the Scarlet Crusade, the Kingdom of Stormwind's allies in Hillsbrad, and troll tribes hold isolated frontiers.

faq.q: What happened to the original living humans of Lordaeron?
aliases: where did the people of lordaeron go
faq.answer: Most of Lordaeron's people died during the Third War, struck down by the plague of undeath or Arthas's Scourge army. Many dead were raised into mindless servitude, then later regained their minds and became the Forsaken. The living who survived fled south to Stormwind, sailed to Kalimdor with Jaina Proudmoore, or joined militant enclaves such as the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: Why was the subcontinent named Lordaeron?
faq.answer: The northern land took its name from the city-state of Lordaeron, which rose after the ancient Empire of Arathor and became one of humanity's most powerful kingdoms. Its name eventually spread across the whole subcontinent.

faq.q: Where is the Capital City of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: The Capital City of Lordaeron stands on the northern shore of Lordamere Lake in Tirisfal Glades. Its surface streets and palace courtyards lie in silent ruins, while Sylvanas Windrunner has turned the catacombs below into the Undercity, capital of the Forsaken.

faq.q: Is Lordaeron part of the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Lordaeron is bitterly contested. Its kingdom founded and led the original Alliance of Lordaeron. Now the Undercity is an official Horde capital and western Lordaeron is a Horde stronghold, while Alliance forces struggle to hold their few outposts in Hillsbrad and Arathi.

angles.text: Lordaeron was your homeland in life. You walk the Capital City's ruined courtyards as an heir claiming what is yours under Lady Sylvanas.
For humans of the Alliance, Lordaeron is a sacred tragedy. It was the cradle of the Holy Light and leader of the original Alliance. Seeing undead overrun its halls brings grief and fury.
The Alliance once took its name from Lordaeron. Now its footholds in Hillsbrad and its fight against the Scourge in the Plaguelands mark a painful struggle to recover human heritage.
Through their Forsaken allies, the Horde holds a vital, contested foothold in the northern Eastern Kingdoms. It surrounds Alliance outposts and confronts the Scourge's remnants.
The Order of the Silver Hand began in Lordaeron at the Chapel of Alonsus Faol. These northern roads and ruins hold the history of the earliest paladins.
